NOTICE OF UNMANNED MARITIME SYSTEM OPERATIONS IN USCG SOUTHWEST DISTRICT

Autonomous and Unmanned Maritime System (UMS) operations are increasingly common throughout the Coast Guard's Southwest District Area of Responsibility. These activities may include autonomous or remotely operated surface and underwater vessels conducting testing, research, Survey work, security operations, national defense
support, and other uses.

This MSIB requests and encourages UMS operators to provide the Coast Guard advance notice of planned operations within the Southwest District. Early notice improves Coast Guard and mariner awareness and supports safe UMS integration into the regional marine transportation system. Operators should become familiar with CG-5P Work Instruction (WI) 5P-WI-002(1) Oversight of Unmanned, Autonomous, and Remote-Control Operations,
